g.text: Synthetic aperiodic decode ledger: Poisson arrivals, lognormal lengths, seeded. Per-layer interleaving of weight and KV reads, as real decode issues them.

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Trace replay of a synthetic ledger, not a measurement and not a real serving trace. Both tier sides are counted; bypass and managed both hold steady-state fill at 0. A real trace (ShareGPT, Azure) has a different churn distribution and would move the delta.
